label: ①コスト妥当：堅実に光る
add: PLAN "STANDARD" (reasonable cost, solid and bright): A clean rectangular layout mostly reusing modular Re-booth parts. The NOC screen is built from SEVERAL medium flat-panel monitors in a tidy video-wall grid (3-4 screens), NOT one giant wall. Fabric membrane backlit only at key focal points; remaining walls are clean flat printed brand panels in navy with blue/purple accents. One single LED-lit logo cube near the entrance corner. Top of the truss carries a simple flat illuminated logo sign. Restrained and professional.

label: ②コスト高め：全面発光の洗練
add: PLAN "PREMIUM" (higher cost, fully-glowing sophistication): The ENTIRE truss canopy is wrapped in tensioned fabric membrane fully backlit from inside. The NOC screen is ONE large seamless slightly-curved LED video wall. A glowing illuminated RING/halo sign fits entirely below and inside the fixed 3.6 m truss envelope. Meeting zone uses semi-private low-partition pods with higher-end low furniture. Premium and polished.

label: ③奇抜：∞（無限大）の光のゲート
add: PLAN "IMPACT" (bold/unconventional hero): The hero is a three-dimensional glowing INFINITY gate at the open corner, entirely contained BELOW and INSIDE the fixed 3.6 m truss envelope, big enough to walk through without changing the underlay silhouette. NOC content appears on a curved multi-facet LED. Dynamic blue-to-purple light. Still buildable from truss, membrane and LED.
